composio.note: No managed Xero app. Create an auth config with your own client ID and secret, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio has no managed Xero app, so you must register your own OAuth app with Xero and supply its client ID and secret in a Composio auth config.
reasons: No managed Xero app exists in Composio
Consent screen shows your brand instead of Composio's
Dedicated rate-limit quota instead of one shared across all Composio users

scenarios.label: Listed in Xero App Store, multi-customer agent
scenarios.when_this_applies: You want outside customers to connect through a certified, listed app, which is the documented route in the evidence.

hands_on.basis: Estimate from the steps; the assessment alone typically takes about 5 working days (c14).

waiting.basis: No verified source backs this timeline (the agent's estimate was "5-10 working days for the assessment review; partner acceptance time unknown").

scenarios.approval: Partner program application, certification, a security assessment reviewed by Xero's security team, and listing review. Advanced assessment at 1000+ connections. Repeated yearly.

Implement Sign Up with Xero before listing

prerequisites.title: Own Xero OAuth app
prerequisites.detail: Composio has no managed Xero app, so register an app with Xero and supply its client ID and secret.

prerequisites.title: Sign Up with Xero implemented
prerequisites.detail: Implement it before submitting your listing for review. Sign in with Xero already provides the minimum two-step authentication.

prerequisites.title: Security documentation
prerequisites.detail: The requirements cover authentication, encryption, personnel security and audit logging, among others. Prepare these answers before starting.

steps.title: Apply to Xero App Partner Program
steps.detail: Apply with your company details and begin certification.

steps.title: Register Xero OAuth app
steps.detail: Create the app in the Xero developer portal and note the client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: You hold a client ID and secret.

steps.title: Validate redirect URIs
steps.detail: Check that each redirect URI is absolute, has no wildcards, and that the total is within 50. Use the URI from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: All URIs pass the checks and are registered.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the xero auth config through Composio's API with your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test connection succeeds.

steps.title: Implement Sign Up with Xero
steps.detail: Add the sign-up flow to the app before submitting the listing.
steps.done_when: Sign Up with Xero works end to end.

steps.title: Draft security assessment answers
steps.detail: Prepare answers on authentication, encryption, personnel security and audit logging from your system design.
steps.done_when: Draft answers are ready for your review.

steps.title: Complete and submit assessment
steps.detail: Check the answers are accurate, then submit. Expect about 5 working days of work.

steps.title: Xero security review
steps.detail: Xero's security team reviews the answers and may ask extra questions. It emails the result.
steps.done_when: You receive a pass email or a remediation report.

steps.title: Remediate if report received
steps.detail: Send a remediation plan within 30 days, then implement changes within 60 days. Xero then re-reviews.

steps.title: Write and submit app listing
steps.detail: An agent can draft the listing text; you submit it in the Xero Developer Centre.

traps.title: Listing needs partner status first
traps.detail: You must apply to the App Partner Program and complete certification before you can qualify to list. Acceptance time and criteria were not found.

traps.title: Assessment repeats every year
traps.detail: You must pass the security assessment annually, and an advanced one applies at 1000 or more connections. The docs also say 'more than 1,000' in one place.

traps.title: Redirect URI rules are strict
traps.detail: Wildcards are not allowed, URIs must be absolute, and the limit is 50.

traps.title: Failing adds months
traps.detail: A remediation report gives 30 days for a plan and 60 days to implement, followed by a re-review.

traps.title: Some APIs are assessed regardless of size
traps.detail: All consumers of the Practice Manager, Xero HQ and Xero Tax APIs are covered, and Xero can add others.

blockers.symptom: Cannot list or be certified in the Xero App Store
blockers.what_it_means: The security assessment has not been passed or the partner program was not completed.
blockers.what_to_do: Complete the partner application and pass the security assessment.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft assessment answers and a remediation plan.

blockers.what_it_means: Some items did not meet the security requirements.
blockers.what_to_do: Submit a plan within 30 days and implement the changes within 60 days.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the remediation plan and propose code or config changes.

evidence.question: G9

evidence.question: G9

evidence.answer: Your proxy endpoint must return a 302 redirect, and must not follow the redirect server-side or make a fetch call to Composio.
